title: The Queen Bee
summary: Two elder princes went seeking adventure and fell into reckless, idle living. Their youngest brother, whom they called Simpleton (Dummling), went to bring them home....
full_text:
Two elder princes went seeking adventure and fell into reckless, idle living. Their youngest brother, whom they called Simpleton (Dummling), went to bring them home.

Along the road, the elder brothers wanted to destroy an anthill, kill ducks on a pond, and smoke out a beehive. Dummling stood before them each time: "Leave them in peace; I will not suffer you to torment them!"

They arrived at an enchanted castle where all inhabitants were turned to stone. To break the spell, three tasks had to be solved:

First, collect a thousand pearls of the princess scattered under the moss in the forest; the grateful ants gathered every single pearl before sunset!

Second, fetch the key to the princess's bedchamber from the deep lake; the grateful ducks dove down and brought the key from the mud!

Third, identify the youngest and sweetest of the three sleeping princesses, whose lips looked identical; the grateful Queen Bee flew in and tasted the honey upon the lips of the true maiden!

The spell broke instantly: the castle awakened, and Dummling married the youngest princess, while his reformed brothers married her sisters, reigning in peace and gratitude.
moral: Kindness to the small and defenseless is rewarded with victory when the great tasks arrive.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Queen Bee"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
